data.exact_reserve_text: The claims incurred, as stated within the financial statements of GBP 7.2m (2014: GBP 5.5m) includes a deterioration of GBP 2.2m on 2013 & prior years and a marginal movement on the other years of account (2014: GBP 0.3m deterioration) in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end principally due to the adverse developments of legacy European creditor reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Legacy European creditor and Group business development
prior_year_events.impact_description: Worse than expected development primarily on legacy European creditor and Group business, leading to a GBP 2.2m deterioration on 2013 & prior years and a GBP 0.3m deterioration on other years of account (2014).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a GBP 2.5m strengthening of gross reserves for prior underwriting years, primarily driven by adverse claims development on legacy European creditor and Group business. This deterioration affected the 2013 and prior years of account by GBP 2.2m and other years of account (2014) by GBP 0.3m.
raw_causal_phrases: worse than expected development primarily on legacy European creditor and Group business
deterioration of GBP 2.2m on 2013 & prior years
marginal movement on the other years of account (2014: GBP 0.3m deterioration)
adverse developments of legacy European creditor reserves
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 17 shows a net release for prior years, which contradicts the explicit narrative statement of deterioration on page 16. The narrative statement is used as the primary source for prior year development due to its explicit quantification and causal explanation.
